missionPremise: WDLL item 7 (P-54 PE): inspect cites owner-fact from cortex-root ownerFact on an identified session, or an honest miss that names the atom. Anonymous inspect has no owner body. Cortex already serving anonymous gold as ownerFact.state=refused code=identified-session-required source=owner-fact with no ownerName and no mailing (item 7 cortex half; field names frozen from _inbox/2026-08-22_p54_cortex_execute.json liveGet). Gold store hit is 48021:34137:2025. Writer key is ${parcelNodeId}:${taxYear}. Fail if anonymous sees owner. Fail if identified is CAD-roll bake (cad-parcel-roll / cad_property / GIS ParcelCardData.owner) presented as the atom. Do not copy the special-district :sd: picker. Do not copy pipeline ANY bind. Do not share the texas-rrc key. This card implements against fixtures. No deploy. Sources: _dispatches/2026-08-22_serve-pe-p54_dispatch.md; _inbox/2026-08-22_p54_cortex_execute.json; _inbox/2026-08-22_p54_cortex_planner_review.json; hauska-map PR 181 at 3f7a048.
completionPredicate: mergeBakedBaseFacts copies a fixture ownerFact from the cortex JSON ROOT onto the atom-chain payload and does not copy bake / CAD-roll / cad-parcel-roll / GIS owner onto that field. A missing field stays missing. Early return with no facets still attaches the root field. Inspect Owner row (label Owner, testid inspect-owner) reads ownerFact only. Anonymous / identified-session-required fixture has no owner body and no ownerName. Identified gold-shaped present fixture cites source=owner-fact entityId=48021:34137:2025 taxYear=2025. Typed state=refused code=atom-miss stays visible as an honest miss that names owner-fact and does not render a CAD-roll name. A bake / CAD-roll / GIS owner object parked on the root without state, or with source other than owner-fact, is rejected. fetchCortexFacetsWithAlias retries when ownerFact is missing even if flood / land-use / special-district / pipeline / well / footprint / boundary are already present. Integer gold is the live probe. texas-rrc stays live:false. Identified inspect forwards pe_session Bearer, never service key / X-Hauska-Key. Diff uncommitted. No deploy. Live paired smartsite.cloud probes are leave_behind.
scopeBasis: PE BFF copy plus inspect Owner row / resolver plus session-Bearer forward on the existing pe_session cookie. Cortex owns the atom read (already serving). Live inspect is atom-chain-warm so mergeBakedBaseFacts is the live path. Do not adopt bake / CAD / cad-parcel-roll / GIS owner as ownerFact. Do not treat service key / X-Hauska-Key as identified. Do not invent Clerk/Stripe. Do not add a :sd: picker. Do not copy pipeline ANY bind. Do not start P-52. Do not flip texas-rrc or mud-pid. Do not occupy P:/hauska-map or the property seat checkout. Do not paste live ownerName or mailing into _inbox JSON. ParcelFactSheet stays frozen on required fields; owner is additive optional so stubs do not break. identity.owner stays the existing public-tier uncovered absence and is not this row.

fieldContract.name: ownerFact
fieldContract.placement: JSON ROOT sibling of facets / tier2 / floodHazardFact / landUseFact / specialDistrictFact / pipelineFact / wellFact / buildingFootprintFact / boundaryEdgeFact, copied root-to-root onto PeBakedFacetsResponse. adversarialReview.objection: Rename a CAD-roll bake or GIS ParcelCardData.owner field to ownerFact and call that the atom.
adversarialReview.response: Dispatch forbids adopting bake / CAD / cad-parcel-roll / GIS owner as that field. Cortex already writes a ROOT sibling from owner-fact atoms. Copying CAD-roll would look like a merge win while remaining starved of the atom.
adversarialReview.disposition: ROOT only. Type guard requires state present|absent|refused. Resolver requires source=owner-fact.

adversarialReview.objection: Always send CORTEX_SERVICE_API_KEY so the BFF stays simple; identified will come later.
adversarialReview.response: If the BFF always sends an operator key, owner stays the anonymous refusal. That is correct for anonymous and wrong for identified inspect. Cortex authenticatedBrokerageUserId requires a dotted session Bearer. Forward pe_session.
adversarialReview.disposition: Cookie present → session Bearer. Cookie absent → service key. Never X-Hauska-Key as identified.

adversarialReview.objection: Invent a Clerk or Stripe identified check on the PE BFF.
adversarialReview.response: Dispatch: quote the existing PE session mechanism. Do not invent Clerk/Stripe. pe_session + spine-deep Bearer forward already exists.
adversarialReview.disposition: Reuse readPeSessionCookie. No new identity vendor.

adversarialReview.objection: Flip texas-rrc live:true because inspect is about to be wired.
adversarialReview.response: Owner does not share that key. Registry emptyBasis says the GIS layer has no source. Dispatch: do not add a GIS owner overlay.
adversarialReview.disposition: Leave live:false. Say so in the close.

adversarialReview.objection: Show identity.owner (public-tier uncovered absence) as the inspect Owner row.
adversarialReview.response: identity.owner is not ownerFact. The inspect Owner row reads ownerFact only. CAD-roll / paid-facet prose is not the atom.
adversarialReview.disposition: New additive sheet.owner from ownerFact. identity.owner stays untouched.
